text:
jessica: Heads-up — GammaHealth (enterprise) just escalated to legal: they say audit logs for 2026-02-14 stop at ~14:23 UTC while activity continued. They claim missing patient-consent events. Need triage + mitigation now, cc @sec-ops @lia-support

lia-support: Got it. Do we have the customer's log snippet or request ID? Also what infra region/service? I can do the external comms once we know scope.

samir: Which logging pipeline? audit-collector -> s3 archive -> indexer? I can check ingestion and indexer status. Any recent infra changes or key rotations in the window?

mike-infra: I pushed an HSM/KMS key rotation last night at 02:15 UTC in us-west-2 for the audit-signing key (k-audit-v3). No infra deploys during 14:00 UTC window. Will check if rotation caused signing/ingest rejection.

sec-ops: Treat as compliance priority. If logs missing for patient-consent events we need to contain and notify legal. Short term: preserve all artifacts, do not modify archives in place. Also open an internal KMS incident and mark P1 if evidence of tampering.

eng-oncall-bot: Alert: deploy.audit-indexer failed 2026-02-14T14:24:12Z -> exit 1 (signature verification). Link: https://deploys.redwood/in/12345

jessica: Customer pasted snippet showing time gap and 'consent_granted' events after 14:23 missing. They attached two log files (we have s3 pointers). They requested ETA and whether this is a security incident.

samir: Quick checks I'm running: 
- s3 ls s3://audit-archives/gammahealth/2026-02-14/ | tail -n 20
- grep -n "consent_granted" /tmp/gamma-pull.log | tail
Also checking indexer logs around 14:23 for signature errors.

mike-infra: I see s3 objects present up to 14:59 for that day. Indexer failed to import some chunks around 14:24 with signature mismatch. HSM rotation log shows key version bump and subsequent sign requests returned 400 from KMS for ~90s.

samir: Proposed immediate mitigation steps:
1) Rehydrate missed objects from archive (cold storage) to a recovery bucket. 
2) Re-run indexer for 14:20-14:40 with signature-verification disabled to recover entries for customer-facing timeline. 
3) In parallel, preserve the original objects and collect HSM logs for forensics.
Commands I'm about to run:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://audit-archives/gammahealth/2026-02-14/14/ s3://audit-recovery/gammahealth/2026-02-14/14/ --recursive --exclude "*gz*" --include "*"
audit-indexer --start 2026-02-14T14:20:00 --end 2026-02-14T14:40:00 --bucket s3://audit-recovery/gammahealth --verify-signatures=false
```

lia-support: Draft reply for GammaHealth: "Thanks — we see an ingestion disruption during 14:23 UTC due to an internal key rotation causing temporary signature failures. We are reprocessing your logs now; ETA initial recovery 3 hours, full forensic report within 72 hours. Preserving original logs; no evidence yet of external tampering. We'll update in 30 minutes." Want to add anything else?

sec-ops: Good first draft. Add: we will not delete or alter originals, and legal/incident response is looped in. Do NOT claim root cause until forensics complete. Also start a TLP:AMBER if customer data involved.

mike-infra: I'm starting key-rollback plan if reprocessing with verify=false isn't acceptable. Rolling keys back could restore normal signing but has risk; will coordinate maintenance window. ETA for recovery run (non-rollback) ~2.5-3h. I'll update in 15.

samir: Recovery run started at 1775559220. If reprocess succeeds we should see missing consent events in index within ~20-30m. I'll post results.

jessica: Customer asked whether this maps to a CVE / vulnerability disclosure. Short answer for now: no public CVE; this is an operational regression triggered by internal rotation sequence and a bug in retry handling. We will assess exploitability and follow CVE process if warranted.

sec-ops: Opened internal ticket SEC-2026-042 and flagged for potential CVE review. Assigned to @mike-infra and @samir.

eng-oncall-bot: Recovery job audit-indexer-recovery-1775559220 completed with status: SUCCESS. Missing entries reindexed: 38.

samir: Reindex completed and I verified 38 previously-missing consent_granted events. Reconciliation script shows no deletes. Signatures were missing on a handful of objects due to transient KMS 400s.

lia-support: Sending customer update now with recovery confirmation and ETA for forensic report. Copying your suggested wording plus note: "we are treating this as high priority and will provide a root cause and remediation timeline within 72 hours."

mike-infra: Follow-ups: implement stricter rollback checks for key rotation, add a 5m retry/backoff for KMS errors in signer client, and add archive verification alerts. I'll open infra PRs and an ops runbook.

sec-ops: Keep SEC ticket updated with artifacts. If legal asks for chain-of-custody, preserve signed and unsigned copies.

jessica: Thanks all. Customer calmed for now; legal wants the forensic packet. We'll aim for the 72h report. :thumbsup: :eyes:
